records_outside_main.name: DynaMate (Mendible-Barreto et al.)
records_outside_main.reason: Distinct from Guilbert's protein–ligand DynaMate. Official repository https://github.com/omendibleba/DynaMate was read and confirms LLM-controlled LAMMPS preparation, minimization, NPT/NVT execution and postprocessing. The cached primary publisher response describes solvent/MOF and alanine-dipeptide examples, but direct paper/PDF and output notebooks could not be opened. Retained outside the contributed main records until concrete target/output evidence can be inspected without relying on a search response alone. Journal date22May2025 is supported by author institution https://scholarworks.merrimack.edu/cs_facpub/39/.

records_outside_main.name: ChatMat
records_outside_main.reason: Primary publisher search text and official repository https://github.com/Xiaobu-USTC/ChatMat support a separately described multi-agent DFT/ML-PES execution architecture. Direct main text and SI opens failed, and the repository evaluation-results directory was inaccessible. Concrete demonstrated physical targets and dated earliest report remain unverified, so not forced into extended materials based on the title.

records_outside_main.name: ISAAC / agentic XPS framework (Shen and Qian)
records_outside_main.reason: Official author page https://qiangrouppage.lbl.gov/research identifies the submitted XPS system as ISAAC. Original ChemRxiv report could not be opened. Search/secondary text indicates structure generation, relaxation, core-hole calculations and human control, but precise targets and executed agent contribution are not independently coded. Survey gives28July2026 as a discovery lead, not verified date here.

records_outside_main.name: MatBrain
records_outside_main.reason: Journal abstract and 42-page original SI read. SI TableS1 lists MatGL crystal relaxation in the tool pool used in evaluation, but its displayed worked examples and screening tables mostly demonstrate generation, scalar properties, XRD and wet synthesis. A listed relaxation function alone is not credited as an executed relaxation result. Resolving the original Fig.S7 tool calls or main-text methods would determine inclusion; original SI https://media.springernature.com/original/springer-static/esm/art:10.1038%2Fs42256-026-01298-6/MediaObjects/42256_2026_1298_MOESM1_ESM.pdf.

records_outside_main.name: MOFGen
records_outside_main.reason: Original report fully inspected. LLMs propose chemical formulae/linkers and synthesis plans; actual MACE/xTB/DFT geometry optimization is performed by described fixed QForge/QHarden pipelines. No clear evidence that an LLM plans, invokes or revises the atomistic calculation itself was located. Under the chosen computational-agent boundary, downstream quantum validation alone does not convert generative design into an eligible agentic simulator. Keep this explicit borderline exclusion for sensitivity.

records_outside_main.name: Autonomous Materials Simulation with an LLM Agent: Modeling Exothermic Fronts in 2D Ferroelectrics
records_outside_main.reason: Official APS abstract dated18March2026 names ChenmuZhang and BorisYakobson and the same CuInP2S6 force-field/MD research as MatClaw. No second system is counted. Exact equivalence of implementation and whether this should move MatClaw's first-public date requires the authors' identification, so the more specific April arXiv date remains in the contributed record.

records_outside_main.name: MatPilot
records_outside_main.reason: Found as an early materials-research multi-agent/human–machine system. Original full HTML unavailable during this pass; actual executed atomistic simulation contribution not verified, so title/ambition does not cause inclusion.

records_outside_main.name: From data to theory: Autonomous large language model agents for materials science
records_outside_main.reason: Discovery describes equation selection and code fitting/testing against materials data. No positive atomistic calculation execution evidence obtained; not included merely for autonomous theoretical modeling.

records_outside_main.name: LLM-based AI agents for automated extraction of material properties and structural features
records_outside_main.reason: Reported contribution is literature-derived materials data extraction and schema verification, with no verified executed atomistic simulation.

records_outside_main.name: Verification-first autonomous catalysis
records_outside_main.reason: Perspective on verification/metrics, not a separately executed system.

records_outside_main.name: A Universal Autonomous Agent for Atomistic Simulation and Benchmarking Its Capabilities
records_outside_main.reason: FengxuYang/JackEvans AI4X report is the QUASAR system, not an additional agent.

records_outside_main.name: DynaMate (Guilbert et al.)
records_outside_main.reason: Distinct protein/protein–ligand MD system; handled by the molecular-dynamics/soft-matter researcher to avoid duplicate contributions.

records_outside_main.name: Tensor-network simulation agent (Li, Ren, Cheng and Gong)
records_outside_main.positive_evidence: Agents generate and run Renormalizer tensor-network code, validate convergence and revise calculations. A retinal photoisomerization example evolves a two-state 25-mode vibronic Hamiltonian.
records_outside_main.reason: The chemistry example is a reduced torsion/stretch/oscillator model with prescribed Hamiltonian and parameters, rather than molecular electronic-structure calculations or atomistic trajectories. Retain separately as quantum-dynamics sensitivity; do not silently broaden the main denominator.

records_outside_main.name: AutoSolvateWeb
records_outside_main.positive_evidence: The platform executes explicit-solvent molecular simulation workflows via an intent-based Dialogflow chatbot.
records_outside_main.reason: Original article explicitly assigns calculation setup to predefined dialog states/intents; the generative LLM fallback handles out-of-scope questions and redirects users. Actual simulations therefore do not establish LLM planning, invocation or feedback decisions under the present criterion. Do not conflate it with the later AutoSolvate-Agent.

records_outside_main.name: LARA-HPC
records_outside_main.locator: Section IV Dry-Run Driven Validation; Section V.1–V.3
records_outside_main.positive_evidence: LLM-generated BigDFT workflows are iteratively repaired using native diagnostics, including invalid spin inputs and a water centroid API error; an anatase/water case obtains resource estimates.
records_outside_main.reason: The inspected worked demonstrations emphasize code repair and native dry-runs, and Section IV explicitly says no full SCF cycle occurs in a dry-run. Completed production electronic-structure outputs were not established in this screening; an atomization-energy workflow description alone is insufficient to mark executed E.

records_outside_main.name: Q-planner
records_outside_main.locator: Conference program, talk 1C03; authors Ruiqi Zhang, Wenhao Gao and Yuki Kurashige
records_outside_main.reason: Primary conference program confirms the title and authors. The original ChemRxiv report and concrete computation demonstrations were not retrieved, so the perspective's broad capability list is not converted into main-sample task marks.

records_outside_main.name: Universal Structure Generator (Pollice group)
records_outside_main.reason: A distinct plugin agent for computational chemistry was identified by the authors' primary group page, but execution of quantum/atomistic relaxation beyond structural generation was not established.

records_outside_main.name: El Agente Cuántico
records_outside_main.reason: An executed quantum-simulation multi-agent framework was found, but a molecular electronic-structure or atomistic demonstration was not established. Model-Hamiltonian-only demonstrations would remain adjacent rather than join the main sample.

records_outside_main.name: ArIA
records_outside_main.locator: Original ChemRxiv abstract and version history; author group preprint 27
records_outside_main.positive_evidence: The original preprint describes a locally deployable open-source LLM agent that interprets user instructions, performs simulations with ORCA, and produces visualizations and reports for molecular DFT/TDDFT work.
records_outside_main.reason: Original abstract positively states that the local LLM agent performs ORCA simulations. Direct full-text access returned HTTP 403, and concrete worked molecular cases and individual task evidence were not established. Retained outside main pending primary full-text screening rather than treating implementation claims as verified demonstrations.

sources.evidence_paraphrase: The original preprint describes a locally deployable open-source LLM agent that interprets user instructions, performs simulations with ORCA, and produces visualizations and reports for molecular DFT/TDDFT work.
The authors' group page identifies ArIA as a distinct molecular-simulation agent and links its revised ChemRxiv version, avoiding confusion with unrelated ARIA systems.

aliases: Molecular Simulations Assisted by an Artificial Intelligence Agent (ArIA)

records_outside_main.name: Polymer-Agent / PolyAgent
records_outside_main.locator: Methods, Table2/Summary of Tools; Workflow; Open Challenges and Future Work
records_outside_main.reason: The original report exposes generative/predictive model tools and RDKit validation for polymer SMILES discovery. It places integration of computational characterization and molecular dynamics in future work. No agent-executed atomistic simulation is demonstrated; arXiv:2601.16376 and DOI:10.1021/acs.jcim.6c00343 are counterparts of this same excluded system.

records_outside_main.name: AutoSolvateWeb
records_outside_main.reason: The original describes predefined intent/dialog flows collecting simulation keywords and triggering the automated backend. Generative LLM fallback only replies to unmatched/out-of-scope questions and redirects the conversation. Actual QM/MM/MD execution is demonstrated, but no LLM planning, computational tool selection, input modification or scientific feedback decision is shown. This is narrower than claiming no LLM is present.

records_outside_main.name: Large language models design sequence-defined macromolecules via evolutionary optimization
records_outside_main.locator: Main text introduction of optimizer; Methods/LLM prompts
records_outside_main.reason: The original explicitly takes a learned RNN approximation as ground truth and does not validate the full MD-to-morphology mapping in this work. LLM feedback distances come from that surrogate, not agent-invoked dynamics. Historical MD training data and MD-themed prompts do not establish an executed agentic atomistic workflow.

records_outside_main.name: DynAgent
records_outside_main.locator: Workshop title/author list and abstract; arXiv:2512.10034v1
records_outside_main.reason: Same Guilbert/Masschelein/Goumaz/Naida/Schwaller system as the biomolecular DynaMate. Name and evaluation-set size changed between reports; count once. Workshop posting date remains unresolved because the primary forum and metadata access returned challenge/403.

records_outside_main.name: DynaMate (de Gillis et al., LAMMPS)
records_outside_main.reason: A separate group and software stack use the DynaMate name for LAMMPS/Moltemplate molecular workflows. It must not be merged with Guilbert's protein–ligand framework. Primary screening and record are owned by the materials research file to prevent duplicate entries.

records_outside_main.name: Multi-agentic AI framework for end-to-end atomistic simulations / LAMMPS-Agents
records_outside_main.locator: Abstract and first-published metadata; Methods and worked elemental/alloy examples
records_outside_main.reason: Vriza/Kornu/Koneru/Chan/Sankaranarayanan framework (first published 9 December 2025) uses actual LAMMPS/Atomsk/Phonopy simulations. This is not either DynaMate. Demonstrated targets are elemental/alloy materials, and the materials researcher owns the record.

records_outside_main.name: Electrolyte agent (ICLR 2026, OpenReview MEXl18VhBL)
records_outside_main.locator: Indexed original PDF §§3.1 and 4; alternative original asset 837f62f17b0f4210dbc1260e813b7fd1ebabd467.pdf
records_outside_main.reason: Primary search results describe an MD-assistant and a discovery agent executing electrolyte simulations, potentially eligible. Direct PDF/forum reads encountered a verification challenge and metadata endpoint access failed; title/author identity, earliest date, full workflow and deduplication were not resolved. Do not add to the denominator from snippets alone.

records_outside_main.name: gromacs_smolagent
records_outside_main.reason: Official repository describes a Smolagents interface for GROMACS and a January 2026 presentation. A specific executed simulation example and first public project date were not independently established in this pass; retain as a lead rather than counting tool availability alone.

records_outside_main.name: OHMind MD Agent
records_outside_main.reason: Official docs describe polymer/ion-exchange membrane system building, GROMACS execution and transport analysis tools. A dated executed atomistic case and independent system identity/publication were not established in this pass.

records_outside_main.name: AIonopedia
records_outside_main.reason: Primary abstract presents an LLM-orchestrated multimodal property predictor, screening/design and wet-lab validation. No agent-executed atomistic calculation was established from the inspected evidence. Full-text confirmation is incomplete, so this is an adjacent unresolved candidate, not a definitive claim that the project lacks simulation capabilities.

records_outside_main.name: CatGo
records_outside_main.reason: Official repository https://github.com/Hello-QM/catgo-LRG and author CP2K announcement confirm geometry tools, an agent-driven DAG workflow executor and QC/MD integrations. Publisher HTML/PDF and ChemRxiv 10.26434/chemrxiv.15002984/v1 were inaccessible in this pass; keep implemented support distinct from inspected executed case evidence. Important architectural neighbour requiring full-paper review, not an absence-of-capability claim.
records_outside_main.locator: Official README, Releases v1.4.14, CP2K discussion 5221; paper DOI

records_outside_main.name: Mimosa
records_outside_main.reason: Original report evaluates ScienceAgentBench data-driven research tasks and workflow evolution. This pass did not establish an agent-executed molecular/atomistic calculation case; generic simulation language or computational-chemistry dataset labels do not suffice for the main denominator.

records_outside_main.name: Science Done on a Machine by a Machine
records_outside_main.reason: Perspective and Table 1 provide a major citation-chain seed list of 49 systems. It is a discovery source, not another system, and its capability coding and denominator are not copied into the present dataset.
